summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch or monetization expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth; counsel_required for upstream rights, public data display, affiliate, advertising, trademark, image, price, and alert-use decisions. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and keep permission outreach unsent. Evidence: Woot documentation proves API access but not commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, or monetization rights; public terms restrict the proposed uses. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics quality is yellow due to source permission or collector errors. Operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results. Revenue evidence is partial aggregate and does not support site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal-lift claims. Ordinary bounded growth may continue only when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, data, and platform-policy boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, security, attribution, measurement, and owner evidence remain incomplete. Progress: official Woot API, terms, support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms are attached. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not change launch state, production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or outreach.

Data-use review decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, and alerts; attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory. No data-use item is clear or conditional for public beta on current evidence.

Compliance, data quality, site, analytics, revenue, and launch evidence support containment rather than a go-live decision. Do not block ordinary growth solely because telemetry is incomplete, but do not treat unavailable analytics, revenue, operations, or security evidence as zero or as clearance. For parked or scaffold sites, retain parked/private status until the existing owner, preview/build, compliance, analytics or affiliate readiness, security, measurement, and rollback checklist is evidenced. Next legal action remains the consolidated SearchWoot evidence bundle; no new launch or monetization proposal is supported.

Keep searchwoot.com private and permission outreach unsent. Continue the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle; rights, retention, consent, vendor, accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete.
